companyNameHint: The display name for your company.
descriptionHint: Optional description shown in the company profile.
logoHint: Upload a PNG, JPEG, WEBP, GIF, or SVG logo image.
brandColorHint: Sets the hue for the company icon. Leave empty for auto-generated color.
requireBoardApproval: Require board approval for new hires
requireBoardApprovalHint: New agent hires stay pending until approved by board.
allowSharingVotedOutputs: Allow sharing voted AI outputs with Paperclip Labs
allowSharingVotedOutputsHint: Only AI-generated outputs you explicitly vote on are eligible for feedback sharing.
votesAlwaysSavedLocally: Votes are always saved locally. This setting controls whether voted AI outputs may also be marked for sharing with Paperclip Labs.
generateInviteSnippetHint: Generate an OpenClaw agent invite snippet.
inviteHintTooltip: Creates a short-lived OpenClaw agent invite and renders a copy-ready prompt.
importExportMoved: Import and export have moved to dedicated pages accessible from the <orgLink>Org Chart</orgLink> header.
archiveDescription: Archive this company to hide it from the sidebar. This persists in the database.
archiveConfirmation: Archive company "{{name}}"? It will be hidden from the sidebar.
noCompanySelected: No company selected. Select a company from the switcher above.
schedulerHeartbeatsDescription: Agents with a timer heartbeat enabled across all of your companies.
disableAllConfirmation: Disable timer heartbeats for all {{count}} enabled {{noun}}?
noSchedulerHeartbeats: No scheduler heartbeats match the current criteria.
generalSettingsDescription: Configure instance-wide defaults that affect how operator-visible logs are displayed.
censorUsernameInLogsDescription: Hide the username segment in home-directory paths and similar operator-visible log output. Standalone username mentions outside of paths are not yet masked in the live transcript view. This is off by default.
keyboardShortcutsDescription: Enable app keyboard shortcuts, including inbox navigation and global shortcuts like creating issues or toggling panels. This is off by default.
aiFeedbackSharingDescription: Control whether thumbs up and thumbs down votes can send the voted AI output to Paperclip Labs. Votes are always saved locally.
noDefaultSaved: No default is saved yet. The next thumbs up or thumbs down choice will ask once and then save the answer here.
dontAllowDescription: Keep voted AI outputs local only.
feedbackDevHint: To retest the first-use prompt in local dev, remove the <code1>feedbackDataSharingPreference</code1> key from the <code2>instance_settings.general</code2> JSON row for this instance, or set it back to <code3>"prompt"</code3>. Unset and <code4>"prompt"</code4> both mean no default has been chosen yet.
experimentalDescription: Opt into features that are still being evaluated before they become default behavior.
enableIsolatedWorkspacesDescription: Show execution workspace controls in project configuration and allow isolated workspace behavior for new and existing issue runs.
autoRestartDevServerDescription: In `pnpm dev:once`, wait for all queued and running local agent runs to finish, then restart the server automatically when backend changes or migrations make the current boot stale.
pastePathOrUrl: Paste path, GitHub URL, or skills.sh command
selectSkillToInspect: Select a skill to inspect its files.
selectCompanyToManageSkills: Select a company to manage skills.
addSkillSourceDescription: Paste a local path, GitHub URL, or `skills.sh` command into the field first.
browseSkillsShDescription: Find install commands and paste one here.
searchGitHubDescription: Look for repositories with `SKILL.md`, then paste the repo URL here.
skillCreatedBody: {{name}} is now editable in the Paperclip workspace.
